newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: HORSE RACING-THIEVES STEAL MELBOURNE CUP TROPHY.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-THIEVES STEAL MELBOURNE CUP TROPHY.

text.p: Police are searching for thieves who galloped off with the 1973 trophy from the Melbourne Cup, Australia's most famous horse race, from a racing club display cabinet.

The distinctive three-handled trophy, valued at A$25,000 (US$19,000), was discovered missing on Thursday from the Victoria Racing Club's committee room, but may have been stolen at any time in the past few weeks, said spokesman Terry Clifton.
"The committee room is only used on race days, and because the trophy is in a cabinet with a lot of other trophies...you could walk past it without noticing it was gone," he said.
Police have appealed for help with the trophy's recovery.

The 1973 Melbourne Cup, won by Gala Supreme, was donated to the club by the horse's late owner. First run in 1861, the race is one of the world's richest, offering prize money of A$2.2 million in 1996 and a new trophy every year. (A$1 = US$0.75)
